body: Since 1849, Fortians have been encouraged to be the makers of their own destiny - faber est suae quisque fortunae. This motto underpins the values and expectations of the school.
Why Choose Us?

Our vision for student achievement Fort Street is proud to continue its co-educational traditions. We value the mix of young men and women learning together. We expect students to develop as model citizens and work towards developing individual and collaborative skills and attributes in each student. east

Fort Street is proud to continue its co-educational traditions. We value the mix of young men and women learning together. We expect students to develop as model citizens and work towards developing individual and collaborative skills and attributes in each student.

Extensive range of student opportunities and activities At Fort Street High School, we offer a variety of programs in the classroom and across the school to help students build new skills, make friends and explore new interests. east
At Fort Street High School, we offer a variety of programs in the classroom and across the school to help students build new skills, make friends and explore new interests.

Wellbeing at Fort Street is for all students A focus on wellbeing goes beyond the welfare needs of a few individual students and aims for all students to be healthy, happy, successful and productive individuals who are active and positive contributors to the school and society in which they live. east

A focus on wellbeing goes beyond the welfare needs of a few individual students and aims for all students to be healthy, happy, successful and productive individuals who are active and positive contributors to the school and society in which they live.

It is my honour to serve as Principal of Fort Street High School, a school with a remarkable history and a proud tradition of nurturing some of Australia’s finest minds since its establishment in 1849. As the oldest government high school in Australia, Fort Street has long been a beacon of academic excellence, innovation, and social conscience.

Situated on Gadigal and Wangal land in Petersham, our school community is a vibrant reflection of multicultural Australia. With approximately 920 students representing over 100 Sydney suburbs and speaking around 40 different languages, Fort Street is a harmonious and inclusive environment that celebrates diversity and fosters tolerance and acceptance.

Fort Fest is an evening event for all the school and local community, with music, food, games and stalls. Run jointly by the SRC and P&C as a fundraiser, it is also a great way to meet and connect with other Fort Street families.

Fort Street High School is an academically selective coeducational secondary school and does not have a local area intake.
Entry is competitive and based on academic merit. There is a maximum enrolment of 150 students in each of Years 7-10. There are between 160 and 170 students in each of Years 11 and 12.

We looking forward to welcome everyone back on Tuesday.

The countdown is on for our Year 12 students. We hope your study is going well but that you are also taking time to look after yourselves. Eat well, get plenty of sleep, take breaks and reach out for support when you need it. See you all on Tuesday 13 October 2026 for the first English exam. Remember to be early not just on time. https://www.facebook.com/share/r/14qQd4NQLBt/

We are very proud to share that two of our students, Hyejeong and Clara have been nominated for the ENCORE HSC Showcase. ENCORE presents a selection of outstanding major works by HSC Music students in NSW including performance, composition and musicology. Selected students will take perform at the Sydney Opera House. Congratulations Hyejeong and Clara!
